name: Anemone Questionnaire
source:
You play as a shy woman on a highly-anticipated dinner date with her good friend and long-time crush: the cute and stylish fashion designer Anemone. 

This could be your chance to finally confess your love to him. All you need is the right catalyst...

[From [url=https://madame-photon.itch.io/anemone-questionnaire]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个害羞的女人，与她的好朋友和暗恋对象——可爱又时尚的时装设计师阿尼莫内 (Anemone) 一起参加备受期待的晚餐约会。

这可能是你最终向他表白你的爱的机会。你所需要的只是合适的催化剂……

[来自[url=https://madame-photon.itch.io/anemone-questionnaire]itch.io[/url]]
